overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by having staff poll members by phone to decide an appeal, and held that ratifying the decision at the next meeting did not cure the violation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board decided outside a meeting to appeal a building permit for a hotel, after a chair's statement suggested a quorum had deliberated privately.
allegations.key_passage: A public body may not use a non-member, such as a staff member, to communicate on matters that the Board would otherwise save for discussion at an open meeting.

remedy: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.

Review the Attorney General's Open Meeting Law Training Video #1 (Introduction and Open Meeting Law Definitions) and certify to the office within thirty (30) days of the letter, using the attached form, that it has complied.
